parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

✨
background[bækgraund]n.
A background is a person's education, family, and experience.
• The new teacher had a background in science and math.
✨
bait[beit]n.
Bait is something used to trick a person or thing to do something.
• The best bait for catching fish is a big, fat worm.
✨
chronicle[kranikl]v.
To chronicle something means to record an event or speech.
• The daily newspaper chronicles local and world events.
✨
copper[kapar]n.
Copper is a red-brown metal often used in electric wire and pipes.
• Ancient hunters melted copper to make knives and spears.
✨
disease[dizi:z]n.
A disease is an illness that causes specific problems.
• He had a disease that caused him to lose his hearing.
✨
folklore[fouklo:r]n.
Folklore is the collection of beliefs and stories of a culture.
• India's folklore has stories written in long poems about great warriors.
✨
infect[infekt]v.
To infect someone means to give them an illness.
• The common cold infects hundreds of millions of people each year.
✨
itch[itʃ]v.
To itch means to rub the skin with your fingernails.
• The rough fabric in his shirt made the back of his neck itch.
✨
literature[litaratʃar]n.
Literature is books, plays, and poetry.
• Early American literature covers the poetry and stories from 1500 to 1800.
✨
millennium[mileniam]n.
A millennium is one thousand years.
• Stonehenge is believed to have been built about 5 millenniums ago.
✨
myth[miθ]n.
A myth is a traditional story that explains a culture's history and beliefs.
• In Greece, there was a myth about a woman who had snakes for hair.
✨
promote[pramout]v.
To promote someone means to raise them to a higher position or rank.
• After two years in the company, she was promoted to a manager.
✨
relate[rileit]v.
To relate to something means to have a connection with it.
• A company's plan usually relates to how much profit it can make.
✨
religion[rilidʒan]n.
A religion is a belief in a god or gods.
• Their religion taught that people should forgive their enemies.
✨
sum[sʌm]n.
A sum is a specific amount of money.
• He calculated the numbers to see what the sum of his bills would be.
✨
teller[tela:r]n.
A teller is a person who works with a bank's customers.
• The teller at the bank helped Kelly put money into a savings account.
✨
trustworthy[trʌstwə:rði]adj.
If someone is trustworthy, they are honest and truthful.
• Mary is one of the most trustworthy people I've ever met.
✨
update[ʌpdeit]v.
To update something means to make it more modern.
• We need to update the programs on our computers.
✨
vein[vein]n.
A vein is a tube in the body that carries blood toward the heart.
• The blue veins in my hand are just under my skin.
✨
venom[venam]n.
Venom is a poisonous substance that comes from animals or plants.
• A snake's venom can be used to cure the illnesses it creates.

parts.title: The Teller and the Thieves
parts.content:
A teller at a bank suspected some of her fellow employees of not being very trustworthy. She thought they were stealing. In order to catch them, though, she needed some way to link them to the crime.

She had a background in religion and folklore. She remembered that one religion's literature had a myth that chronicled how a group of thieves was captured.

In the millennium-old story, coins of copper were covered with venom taken from a poisonous snake. The coins were left as bait for the robbers. When they touched the coins, the venom infected their bodies through their skin. The venom ran through their veins, and they all became very sick as if they had a disease. It made their skin purple. The police arrested whoever had purple skin.

She knew she couldn't use venom because it might hurt someone. However, she thought of a way to update the old story. She decided to cover a sum of money with a special powder. If people touched the money, the powder would cause their skin to itch. She placed the stack of money in the bank's safe. No one was supposed to take money from the safe. If somebody did, then they had to be stealing.

Within a few hours, three of her coworkers were scratching their hands and arms. They itched so badly that they couldn't even work. She checked the money, and it was gone. She told her boss what she had done, and he had the thieves arrested. He thanked her and promoted her.

Because events from history often repeat, ancient literature had helped the teller solve a crime. She proved that stories from the past still relate with the problems of today, and they can be helpful in solving problems.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: 1. The reward for finding the lost dog was a very large specific amount.
questions.explanation: specific amount = sum (số tiền cụ thể)

questions.content: 2. When his arm got crushed, it damaged a tube that carries blood to the heart was damaged.
questions.explanation: tube that carries blood to the heart = vein (tĩnh mạch)

questions.content: 3. To which chart does this collection of data have a connection with?
questions.explanation: have a connection with = relate (có liên quan tới)

questions.content: 4. This book records the first years of the king's life.
questions.explanation: records = chronicles (ghi chép lại)

questions.content: 5. Since that pot is made out of a red-brown metal, it gets hot very quickly.
questions.explanation: red-brown metal = copper (đồng)

questions.content: 6. The nation had a party because their country had existed for a thousand years.
questions.explanation: a thousand years = millennium (thiên niên kỷ)

questions.content: 7. Her experience made her the best person for the new job.
questions.explanation: experience = background (nền tảng kinh nghiệm/kiến thức)

questions.content: 8. The poisonous substance from that fish will make you very sick.
questions.explanation: poisonous substance = venom (nọc độc)

questions.content: 9. I wouldn't believe him. He's not very honest.
questions.explanation: honest = trustworthy (đáng tin cậy)

questions.content: 10. The owners of the hotel decided to modernize the computer system.
questions.explanation: modernize = update (cập nhật/hiện đại hóa)

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. What do you need if you want to catch a fish?
questions.explanation: Bạn cần 'bait' (mồi) để câu cá.

questions.content: 2. Which of the following means to be raised to a higher position?
questions.explanation: 'Promote' có nghĩa là được thăng chức (nâng lên vị trí cao hơn).

questions.content: 3. Which would most likely be found in a library?
questions.explanation: 'Literature' (văn học) là thứ thường được tìm thấy trong thư viện.

questions.content: 4. Sometimes, uncomfortable clothes will make you do this?
questions.explanation: Quần áo không thoải mái đôi khi sẽ làm bạn bị 'itch' (ngứa).

questions.content: 5. Which of the following best describes the combination of two numbers?
questions.explanation: 'A sum' (tổng) là kết quả của việc kết hợp các con số.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Match the phrases to make complete sentences (Part A).

questions.content:
1. The bank teller_____ .
a. caused the boy to collapse
b. to all necessary places in the body
c. was once a small pond
d. was over $300
e. in engineering
f. deposited Paul's money into his account
g. from all of the insect bites
h. of the heroic crime-fighter
i. believe that there is a god
j. is rich with tradition
questions.explanation: The bank teller deposited Paul's money into his account.

questions.content: 2. Many religions_____ .
questions.explanation: Many religions believe that there is a god.

questions.content: 3. The nation's folklore_____ .
questions.explanation: The nation's folklore is rich with tradition.

questions.content: 4. The factory's new worker had a background_____ .
questions.explanation: The factory's new worker had a background in engineering.

questions.content: 5. Those veins pump blood_____ .
questions.explanation: Those veins pump blood to all necessary places in the body.

questions.content: 6. The snake's poisonous venom_____ .
questions.explanation: The snake's poisonous venom caused the boy to collapse.

questions.content: 7. The newspaper story chronicled the action_____ .
questions.explanation: The newspaper story chronicled the action of the heroic crime-fighter.

questions.content: 8. One of that culture's myths explains that the ocean_____ .
questions.explanation: One of that culture's myths explains that the ocean was once a small pond.

questions.content: 9. The total sum for staying three nights at the hotel_____ .
questions.explanation: The total sum for staying three nights at the hotel was over $300.

questions.content: 10. Her arm started to itch_____ .
questions.explanation: Her arm started to itch from all of the insect bites.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Match the clauses to make complete sentences (Part B).

questions.content:
1. If you don't stay away from school today,_____ .
a. because they were made from copper
b. but no animals wanted the bait
c. so everyone knew she was trustworthy
d. it had to be updated
e. then you might infect the other students
f. so she could read their literature
g. so he thought he'd caught a disease
h. so his boss promoted him
i. but it turned out that they didn't relate to each other
j. then imagine how much might happen in a millennium
questions.explanation: If you don't stay away from school today, then you might infect the other students.

questions.content: 2. Because the calendar didn't list the new holidays,_____ .
questions.explanation: Because the calendar didn't list the new holidays, it had to be updated.

questions.content: 3. The hunters put some food in the trap,_____ .
questions.explanation: The hunters put some food in the trap, but no animals wanted the bait.

questions.content: 4. She learned to speak the country's language,_____ .
questions.explanation: She learned to speak the country's language, so she could read their literature.

questions.content: 5. The police thought the two crimes might be connected,_____ .
questions.explanation: The police thought the two crimes might be connected, but it turned out that they didn't relate to each other.

questions.content: 6. The pipes were safe for carrying water_____ .
questions.explanation: The pipes were safe for carrying water because they were made from copper.

questions.content: 7. He had done great work for the company for three years,_____ .
questions.explanation: He had done great work for the company for three years, so his boss promoted him.

questions.content: 8. She never shared her friends' secrets with anyone,_____ .
questions.explanation: She never shared her friends' secrets with anyone, so everyone knew she was trustworthy.

questions.content: 9. If you think a lot can happen in a hundred years,_____ .
questions.explanation: If you think a lot can happen in a hundred years, then imagine how much might happen in a millennium.

questions.content: 10. He had a bad cough and a headache,_____ .
questions.explanation: He had a bad cough and a headache, so he thought he'd caught a disease.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension: Answer the questions. (Part A)

questions.content: 1. A teller at a bank thought her fellow employees were trustworthy.
questions.explanation: A teller at a bank thought her fellow employees were stealing. (Not trustworthy)

questions.content: 2. She remembered that one religion's literature had a myth about how thieves were captured.
questions.explanation: Theo bài đọc, cô nhớ lại một thần thoại từ văn học tôn giáo ghi chép lại cách những kẻ trộm bị bắt.

questions.content: 3. The venom in the millennium-old story was taken from a poisonous plant.
questions.explanation: The venom was taken from a poisonous snake.

questions.content: 4. In the millennium-old story, the coins were left as bait for the robbers.
questions.explanation: Đúng, các đồng xu được để lại làm mồi nhử cho bọn trộm.

questions.content: 5. All of her coworkers were scratching their hands and arms.
questions.explanation: Three of her coworkers were scratching their hands and arms.

questions.content: 6. She proved that stories from the past still relate to the problems of today.
questions.explanation: Đúng, cô đã chứng minh những câu chuyện quá khứ vẫn có thể liên quan và giúp giải quyết vấn đề hiện tại.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension: Answer the questions. (Part B)

questions.content: 1. What is the passage mainly about?
options: a. A teller who stole money
b. How to catch a snake
c. A boss who promoted a thief
d. A teller who used an old story to catch thieves
questions.explanation: Bài đọc kể về một nhân viên ngân hàng dùng một câu chuyện cổ để bắt những kẻ trộm.

questions.content: 2. What did the teller use as bait?
options: b. A sum of money covered in powder
questions.explanation: Cô ấy quyết định phủ một loại bột đặc biệt lên một khoản tiền (a sum of money).

questions.content: 3. Why did the teller update the old story?
options: a. Because she didn't have any copper coins
b. Because she didn't know the whole story
c. Because using real venom could hurt someone
d. Because she wanted to make the powder itch
questions.explanation: Cô ấy biết mình không thể dùng nọc độc (venom) vì nó có thể làm hại ai đó.

questions.content: 4. What happened at the end of the story?
options: a. The thieves arrested the teller
c. The boss stole the money
d. The boss thanked the teller and promoted her
questions.explanation: Người sếp cảm ơn cô và đã thăng chức cho cô (promoted her).
